insights.title: Karachi port strike disrupts electronics supply chain
insights.description: A 3-day strike at Port of Karachi (starting May 15) has caused a ~72hr cargo backlog. Inventory data shows SKU-ELEC-001 in Karachi has only 120 units on hand against a safety stock of 200, with only 2 days cover. Meanwhile, Lahore has 380 units (8 days cover). The strike will likely deplete Karachi stock and may require emergency redistribution from Lahore. The root cause is labor action at a critical port, combined with insufficient safety stock at the affected location.
insights.root_cause: Labor strike at Port of Karachi causing cargo backlog, combined with low safety stock (120 vs 200) and only 2 days cover for a key SKU in Karachi.
insights.forward_implication: If no action is taken, Karachi will stock out of SKU-ELEC-001 within 2 days, leading to lost sales and potential customer dissatisfaction. The backlog may also affect other SKUs and increase demurrage costs.
